title: EzyShield SIEM audit event
description: Stable v1 JSON wire schema produced by internal/siem.FormatJSON. See README.md in this directory for the CEF and RFC 5424 renderings of the same event.

schema_version.description: Wire-schema version. Bumped on any field addition, removal, rename, or meaning change.

timestamp.description: Event time, RFC 3339 in UTC. Empty string when the event time is zero.

vendor.description: Emitting vendor. Defaults to "ezy" when unset by the caller.

product.description: Emitting product. Defaults to "EzyShield" when unset.

version.description: Emitting product version (build info). Defaults to "unknown" when unset.

action.description: Audit operation: ban, dry_ban, unban, expire, allow, arm, disarm, ...

ip.description: Target IP address. OMITTED entirely for system-level events with no target.

rule.description: Matched rule / reason text. Untrusted: may derive from hostile log content.

strike.description: Escalation level 0-5 (0 when not a strike event).

ttl_seconds.description: Ban duration in seconds; 0 means permanent or not applicable.

actor.description: What produced the verdict: rules, ai:anthropic, manual, ... Untrusted.
